<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You build ONE unit of plan 135-rs-boot-announce: u4 one wire frame across harnesses. The omp/pi extension must RENDER an inbound peer message with the rs frame the daemon already uses for Claude seats, and still PARSE the legacy frame. You report to the PM (seat pij-verbal-silverfish), not to prime. WHY, and it is an observability defect rather than cosmetics: omp/pi seats currently render `[pij from <id>] <body>` (.pi/extensions/pij/core/message.ts, frame() at :11-12 and FRAME_RE at :8) while the Rust daemon frames `[pij-rs from <id>]\n<body>\n[/pij]` (crates/core/src/framing.rs RUST_HEAD/TAIL) for Claude seats. Jordan read the legacy head today as 'the old system' — a live-generation message that renders like a dead-generation one is a lie about which system you are on, at the same altitude as the boot announce this plan restores. Plan 135 is the plan that owns 'seats know which system they are on', which is why prime ruled this belongs here as its own unit under a new AC8 rather than in a separate plan. STANDING RULES: NEVER run `flowspace3 daemon` in any form (client verbs only). NEVER start, restart, rebuild or kill the pij-rs daemon — it is the machine's only daemon, it currently runs the PM's worktree binary, and only the PM bounces it under a prime-granted window. NEVER run npm or just install in the MAIN checkout — worktrees only, and a worktree whose node_modules is a SYMLINK to main counts as main (readlink before you write).
